# al-Rayhaanat Design System

> Tokens, components and layout for Daeratul Aqeeq products. v1.3.0, React 18+.
> 148 components across 14 packages, one umbrella install. Light and dark,
> Latin and Arabic, LTR and RTL. Distributed as source JSX on GitHub Packages.

This file is a flat index designed to be pasted into a context window whole. For
the full instruction set, see AGENTS.md.

## Install

npm i @al-rayhaanat/system
Registry: @al-rayhaanat:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com (token with read:packages)
Next.js: transpilePackages: ["@al-rayhaanat/system"] — required, packages ship source JSX
Root: import "@al-rayhaanat/system/tokens.css" once
Vite/Remix/Astro: no config needed

## Model

Theme, direction and language are attributes on <html>, not React state:
  data-theme = light | dark        swaps the semantic colour layer
  dir        = ltr | rtl           mirrors layout, flips directional icons
  lang       = en | ar             selects Kanz al-Lulu and its corrected leading
No provider, no context, no useTheme(), no dark: variants, no second palette.

Hard rules (enforced by @al-rayhaanat/config, these fail the build):
  - semantic tokens only; no raw hex, rgb/hsl/oklch, or ramp steps in app code
  - no arbitrary Tailwind values (p-[13px]); use scale steps
  - no raw pixel values in template strings
  - logical properties only; no marginLeft/right, left/right, textAlign left/right,
    flexDirection row-reverse
  - no lucide-react, react-icons, @heroicons/react, framer-motion
  - no imports of package internals or tokens/dist paths
  - jsx-a11y strict: no div onClick, no autoFocus, no non-interactive tabIndex,
    labels always associated

## Packages

tokens      —   DTCG source and generated targets: CSS vars, TS, Tailwind preset, SCSS, Figma variables, pptx theme, Kanz al-Lulu font. Depends on nothing.
config      —   ESLint, TypeScript, Prettier. The enforcement mechanism. Depends on nothing.
icons       7   Mark, Petal, Spinner, 42 glyphs with mirror flags. Depends on tokens.
motion      8   Transition primitives; prefers-reduced-motion handled once, here. Depends on tokens.
ui          34  Primitives and layout. Depends on tokens, icons.
prose       18  Rich text. Depends on tokens, icons, ui.
contracts   2   Required behaviour as data, plus the minimum test suite. Depends on tokens, icons, ui.
table       6   One headless core, many presentations. Depends on tokens, icons, ui.
filters     13  Declared and dynamic filters with the URL as state. Depends on tokens, icons, ui, table.
patterns    18  Overlays, disclosure, toasts, the four screen states. Depends on tokens, icons, ui, motion.
forms       11  FormField and the aria wiring. Depends on tokens, icons, ui.
shell       10  Four app frames and navigation. Depends on tokens, icons, ui, motion, patterns.
charts      9   Line, area, bar, donut, sparkline, KPI stat. Depends on tokens, icons, ui.
slides      12  Deck layouts and buildDeck() for pptxgenjs. Depends on tokens, icons, ui, charts.
system      —   All of the above in one dependency. Install this.

All packages move together on one version; sibling deps are workspace:*.
Installing a subset loses behaviour silently — patterns without motion ignores
reduced-motion, ui without tokens.css renders unstyled, filters without table
has nothing to filter, shell without patterns has no focus trap.

## Signatures

Button    variant primary|secondary|ghost|danger, size sm|md|lg, icon, iconEnd,
          loading, disabled, block, type
Callout   tone note|accent|success|warning|danger|info, variant bar|card, title, icon
Card      tone default, interactive, as
Stack     gap=5, align                    vertical rhythm
Cluster   gap=3, align=center, justify    horizontal, wraps
Grid      min="240px", gap=5, columns     auto-fit unless columns is given
Split     min="320px", gap=6              two-up that collapses on its own
Container size prose|md|lg|full           78ch | --bp-md | --bp-xl | 100%
Icon      name, size, label, mirror       aria-hidden unless label is passed

Grid and Split reflow on content width, so most responsive work needs no
breakpoint. useBreakpoint() is for structural changes only.

Button sizes: sm 28px/--text-xs/icon 15 · md 36px/--text-sm/icon 16 ·
lg 44px/--text-md/icon 18

## Icons (42)

search plus minus check x chevron-right chevron-left chevron-down chevron-up
arrow-right arrow-left arrow-up-right menu sliders filter user users mail
calendar clock file-text folder book-open bookmark image table layers grid
download upload printer trash pencil eye lock bell star heart external-link
more-horizontal settings log-out

Mirrored under dir=rtl: chevron-right chevron-left arrow-right arrow-left
arrow-up-right external-link log-out filter

Icon size guidance: 16 beside 13–14px text, 20 in buttons, 24 standalone;
above 24 drop strokeWidth to 1.25. The Mark auto-simplifies by size and never
mirrors.

## Tokens

Surface      --canvas --surface --surface-raised --surface-sunken --surface-inverse
Text         --text-primary --text-secondary --text-muted --text-inverse
             --text-on-interactive
Interactive  --interactive --interactive-hover --interactive-active
             --interactive-solid --interactive-solid-hover --interactive-subtle
             --interactive-subtle-hover --secondary --secondary-subtle
Status       --success --warning --danger --info (each with -subtle) --danger-hover
Border       --border --border-hairline --border-control --border-thick
             --border-strong --border-interactive --border-focus --focus-ring
Radius       --radius-none --radius-sm --radius-md --radius-lg --radius-xl --radius-full
Shadow       --shadow-sm --shadow-md --shadow-lg --shadow-xl
Z            --z-base --z-raised --z-sticky --z-dropdown --z-overlay --z-modal
             --z-popover --z-tooltip --z-toast
Duration     --duration-instant --duration-fast --duration-normal --duration-slow
             --duration-deliberate
Easing       --ease-standard --ease-emphasized --ease-exit --ease-spring
Font         --font-body --font-display --font-mono --font-arabic
Weight       --weight-regular --weight-medium --weight-semibold
Tracking     --tracking-tight --tracking-normal --tracking-wide --tracking-kicker
Breakpoint   --bp-sm --bp-md --bp-lg --bp-xl --bp-2xl
Other        --icon-flip (the RTL mirror transform icons consume)

Space   0=0  px=1  1=2  2=4  3=8  4=12  5=16  6=20  7=24  8=32  9=40  10=48
        12=64  14=80  16=96   (px; reference as var(--space-N))
Type    --text-3xs --text-2xs --text-xs --text-sm --text-base --text-md --text-lg
        --text-xl --text-2xl --text-3xl --text-4xl --text-5xl --text-6xl
        each paired with a --leading-* step of the same name
Arabic  --text-ar-* and --leading-ar-* parallel scales, plus --leading-ar-floor
        (1.45; raise to 1.70 for vocalised text whose marks clip)

Ramps, for composing the semantic layer only — never referenced from product
code: --color-{sand,clay,crimson,amber,green,blue,rose,slate}-{50..950},
--color-motif-{core,inner,outer,outer-on-light}, and the named palettes
--palette-{core,petal,endpaper,bindery,colophon,proof,rose-leaf}-{ground,
surface,ink,accent,support}.

Tailwind: presets: [require("@al-rayhaanat/tokens/tailwind")]
CSS-only surfaces (email, print, legacy): tokens.css ships .arh-stack, .arh-grid,
.arh-card, .arh-cluster, which compile to what the React components render.

## Contracts

CONTRACTS is machine-readable — for each family: required states, keyboard,
ARIA, RTL behaviour, motion behaviour, what it must never do, and its minimum
tests. Ten families: Action, Field, Selection, Overlay, Disclosure, Data,
Filters, Feedback, Navigation, Content.

Selected absolutes:
  - never two primary buttons in one action group
  - a loading button keeps its width and sets aria-busy
  - disabled is the real attribute, not reduced opacity
  - a field's error replaces its hint, never both
  - overlays trap focus, close on Escape, restore focus to the trigger
  - focus-visible paints a 2px ring at 2px offset; never removed
  - never a div with onClick
